hypothesis.method: Neuro-symbolic causal reasoning with graph neural networks over temporal intervention data
hypothesis.problem: Inability of current AI systems to reliably infer latent causal structures from noisy observational data in high-dimensional real-world environments
hypothesis.goal: Automated discovery of robust, interpretable causal mechanisms that generalize across domain shifts
